name: re_extract_numbers
code:
import re, math
def numbers(text):
    return [int(m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r"\d+", text)]
xs = numbers("3 14 5")
print(xs, math.sqrt(xs[1]) > 3)

name: count_lines_regex
code:
import re
lines = ["err: disk", "ok: net", "err: mem"]
errs = []
for ln in lines:
    m = re.match(r"err: (.+)", ln)
    if m:
        errs.append(m.group(1))
print(len(errs), errs)
